
# cloudru_mcm_network (Data Source)

Список сетей проекта.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudru_mcm_network" "all" {
  filter {
    # Если не задан, берётся project_id провайдера.
    project_id = "a997b23e-3fce-4636-9bf8-5d264c3d1c06"
  }
}

output "network_ids" {
  value = { for n in data.cloudru_mcm_network.all.resources : n.name => n.id }
}

output "networks_total" {
  value = length(data.cloudru_mcm_network.all.resources)
}

output "default_network_id" {
  value = one([for n in data.cloudru_mcm_network.all.resources : n.id if n.is_default])
}
```

- `resources` (Block List) Найденные сети. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resources))

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `resources`

- `platform_name` (String) Название платформы виртуализации.
